baseline.name: clean_midpoint_reference

slippage.note: TradingView's strategy slippage setting is ticks, not index points.

execution_model.note: Frozen close-fill historical assumption for attribution. Test execution sensitivity separately before production promotion.

baseline.note: This is an attribution baseline, not the previous V6 configuration and not a production recommendation.

experiments.question: Does the v1.3 attribution harness compile and enforce the intended experiment environment, date range, one-trade limit, bracket placement, and 11:00 force-flat behavior?
manual_checks: Pine v6 compiles with zero errors
Dashboard shows ES / 15 and Environment PASS on CME_MINI:ES1! 15m
No trades occur outside the coded historical date range
No more than one entry occurs per New York calendar day
Boundary and Midpoint retests occur only on bars after the breakout arm bar
Open positions are flattened on the bar whose close reaches 11:00 New York
Entry bracket orders exist immediately after valid entry generation
experiments.decision_rule: Do not run attribution experiments until all sanity checks pass.

experiments.question: Does a retest requirement improve expectancy and drawdown versus immediate breakout, and does midpoint outperform boundary retest?
experiments.decision_rule: Keep a retest variant only if expectancy or drawdown improves without relying on a dramatically smaller sample. Do not promote the winning variant without holdout validation.

experiments.question: Which ORB clock performs best under the same entry and risk model?
experiments.decision_rule: Do not choose a clock from net profit alone; require stable expectancy, drawdown, and holdout behavior.

experiments.question: Does directional VWAP alignment add edge to the frozen baseline?
experiments.decision_rule: Keep only if expectancy or drawdown stability improves after accounting for trade-count reduction.

experiments.question: Does a single fixed EMA directional rule add edge?
experiments.decision_rule: No EMA length optimization until the simple off/on test is complete.

experiments.question: Does displacement filtering improve trade quality?
experiments.decision_rule: Run off/on attribution before threshold sensitivity testing.

experiments.question: Does the 5–50 point ORB range gate improve stability?
experiments.decision_rule: Reject if improvement is in-sample only or comes from deleting most trades.
